items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I knew Bunk Johnson very well. Did you get to hear him when you were a kid? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, I don't know. He used to play the Eagles band.

ctx.x: Well, he was a fellow who used to play that trumpet, and he had all them got beats about him. Old man Barbara, you heard him, I'll have to tell you about him. I know you're old boy. He was a nice musician too.
Well, there was Joe Johnson. I knew Bunk Johnson very well. Did you get to hear him when you were a kid?
Yeah, I don't know. He used to play the Eagles band. He used to play a person, and he had Dave the Pass play clarinet with him, Dave. I know all the pass, that's Rudolph, his brother.
